reviews.text: I’m really happy with this product! The quality is great, it’s easy to use, and it feels lovely on the skin. I’ve been enjoying it a lot and would definitely recommend it to others.
reviews.zh: 我真係好滿意呢款產品！質素好好、易用，塗喺皮膚上感覺好舒服。我用得好開心，一定會推薦畀其他人。

reviews.text: A mi me basta leer pantenol y con éso es suficiente para que sea parte de mis mascarillas 🥰 me encanta como me deja la piel todo lo que contiene pantenol
reviews.zh: 我只要見到含有泛醇（panthenol），就已經足夠令佢成為我面膜嘅一部分 🥰 我好鍾意所有含泛醇嘅產品帶畀我皮膚嘅感覺。

reviews.text: This mask felt soothing and helped calm my skin, especially when it was slightly irritated. The hydration was nice but didn’t last all day.
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜感覺舒緩，有助平靜皮膚，特別係皮膚有少少刺激嗰陣。補水效果好好，但係唔可以持續一日。

reviews.text:
Texture: like any Korean sheet mask, very flexible and full of the product

Size: I always struggle with how short they tend to be in the forehead (they are very round, if that makes sense), this one is no exception

Scent: light, not perfume, more like "skincare product", like clean... But it is light

Result: it left my skin moist (not the most moisturizing though, like healthy, plump; so maybe not enough for dry skin) and brightz
reviews.zh:
質地：好似任何韓國布面膜一樣，非常有彈性，精華好充足

尺寸：我一向都覺得額頭位置太短（面膜好圓，如果你明我意思嘅話），呢款都係咁

香味：淡淡嘅，唔係香水味，比較似「護膚品」嗰種，清潔嘅感覺……不過好淡

效果：令皮膚保持濕潤（不過保濕力唔算最強，唔似健康、飽滿嘅感覺；所以對乾性皮膚可能唔太夠）同埋提亮

reviews.text: J'ai teste le sérum anti boutons que j'ai adoré donc j'ai pris ce masque et il est bien. Je ne le rachèterai pas car j'ai mieux mais il est bien.
reviews.zh: 我試過嗰款抗暗瘡精華，我好鍾意，所以買咗呢款面膜，佢都幾好。我唔會再買，因為我已經有更好嘅，不過佢都好好。

reviews.text: My skin likes anything with carrot in it, so I decided to try this facemask. I had low expectations to begin with because face masks never impress me much, but I looooved this mask! My skin felt calmed down and hydrated after! will definitely re-purchase!
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚好啱含有胡蘿蔔嘅嘢，所以我決定試吓呢款面膜。我一開始冇咩期望，因為面膜好少令我覺得好驚喜，但係我超級鍾意呢款面膜！用完之後，皮膚感覺舒緩、水潤！一定會再買！

reviews.text:
It leaks when opening it
didn’t see much difference but it’s expected 
don’t thing I’ll repurchase it
reviews.zh:
打開嗰陣會漏液
睇唔到有咩大分別，但係呢個係預料之內
唔覺得我會再買

reviews.text: my first time using a product from this brand, but it seems really compatible with my needs. I loved how cooling and soothing it was - my skin has been inflamed lately, so I definitely needed this.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第一次用呢個品牌嘅產品，但係感覺好啱我嘅需要。我好鍾意佢嘅清涼同舒緩效果，因為我最近皮膚有發炎，所以真係需要呢款。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
